mechanism: Ketorolac (NSAID) may reduce renal function and increase isoniazid levels; isoniazid is hepatotoxic and ketorolac use increases GI bleeding risk in patients with compromised hepatic function from TB treatment.
action: Monitor hepatic and renal function closely; consider alternative analgesia; use ketorolac at lowest effective dose for shortest duration; assess for signs of isoniazid toxicity.
